identity.description: A user logs in from an unusual country/ASN and executes commands via PowerShell, triggering an abnormal login detection. Cortex should detect the login from anomalous geolocation and the subsequent command execution behavior.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process initiated with web request

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual Login with PowerShell
biocs.description: User login from abnormal country followed by PowerShell execution
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'

abiocs.name: Anomalous Login with PowerShell Execution
abiocs.description: Detection of login from abnormal ASN followed by PowerShell process start
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.10')

xql_queries.name: Unusual Login with PowerShell
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.10')
